title: Snap hook, over a board's edge
summary: A cantilever arm that hooks over the edge of a PCB, so a board with no holes clicks down onto a carrier. Its 45° lead-in opens it as the board goes in; its 45° underside prints without supports and centres the board. The arm stands on a tongue of floor cut free by a U-slot, so a short arm still has spring in PETG. Any board: set its top height, reach and clearance.
firstUsed: Controller project (2026): carriers for the RS485 module

views.label: How it goes in
views.caption: A JZK RS485 module on a 3 × 5 carrier plate: pedestal strip, end stops, a hook on each long edge (the right one with a release tab) and the flex-relief slots round their feet. Drag the slider to push the board down: the arms open over the lead-ins and the hooks snap back over its top. Section cuts in from the side, through both hooks.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four stations for the JZK module on one 1.6 plate, marked with 1 to 4 engraved dots: three hook reaches at 0.3 clearance, and 0.7 at a tighter 0.2. The floor is open between the pedestal and the hooks.

specs.title: The hook
rows: Hook above the board's top edge
specs.note: The underside slope also centres the board: it can shift 0.15 toward a hook before the slope lifts it. Pull the board, or lever an arm back with a fingernail (tab = true adds a lip), to release.
specs.badgeNote: reach and clearance are set by the fit piece

specs.title: The flex relief
rows: 1.0 wide, both sides and in front
Force to hold a hook open
specs.note: Estimates: cantilever at 2 GPa. The fit piece decides. If a station is hard to press in, thin the arm to 1.2 (less than half the force).
specs.badgeNote: snapHookStrain() and snapHookForce() give them for any arm

specs.title: The board it's tested on
specs.note: Any board works: pass its top height. The pins are at the module's ends, so its long edges are free for the hooks.

checks: Push the board down: do both hooks click over, with a thumb's push?
Does it sit flat on the pedestal without rattling, up or sideways?
Lift one end and tug it sideways: does it stay put?
Pull it out: does it come without a hook cracking or staying bent?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, PETG (PLA will crack at the longer reaches).
